newsitem.title: FRANCE: FOCUS-Paribas makes 700 mln Ffr from Allianz sale.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Paribas makes 700 mln Ffr from Allianz sale.

text.p: French holding company Paribas said on Thursday it would post a 700 million franc ($127 million) capital gain from the sale of its stake in an insurance unit, the latest divestment for the French conglomerate.

The sale to Germany's insurance giant Allianz AG Holding also rids Paribas of an insurance stake it did not want, won in a coporate battle seven years ago which gave it control of holding company Cie de Navigation Mixte.
Allianz said earlier in the day it was buying 34 percent of Allianz Via Holding France, held by Paribas through its Mixte unit.

Allianz paid 2.2 billion francs for the stake and gained 100 percent control over Allianz Via Holding France, which it formed with Navigation Mixte in 1990 as part of the latter's failed attempt to fend off the hostile takeover by Paribas.
The sale is the latest in a recent series by Paribas, which is slimming down to concentrate on its core businesses of international investment and merchant banking.

Paribas said on January 9 it was starting talks aimed at quickly selling its Credit du Nord retail banking unit to Societe Generale. It said at the time it expected to make a capital gain of 600 million francs from that deal.
Paribas, through its majority-controlled Sagal unit, also plans a market flotation of its Royal Canin dog food unit.
Market rumours, denied by Paribas, have swirled about a possible sale of Paribas' Cie Bancaire unit.

Paribas chairman Andre Levy-Lang said late last year it would probably shed Via Banque, which it also holds through Navigation Mixte. Paribas said there is no rush on the sale and added that it is not currently in talks on the sale.
Late in 1989, Paribas tried to take over Navigation Mixte, which resisted with the help of Allianz and French companies Societe General, Credit Lyonnais and Framatome.
The deal blocked Paribas, leaving it with about a third of Navigation Mixte until its successful takeover was launched in March 1996.

Allianz ended up holding some nine percent of Navigation Mixte for six years and was 66-percent owner of the newly-formed Allianz Via Holding France, which grouped the insurance activities of Navigation Mixte and Allianz. Allianz sold its stake in Navigation Mixte to Paribas last year.
Under the deal on Thursday Paribas will retain, through Navigation Mixte, Allianz Via's industrial holdings, Paribas said.
Allianz said the purchase would improve its flexibility and efficiency in an increasingly competitive and deregulated European insurance market. ($1=5.526 French Franc)
